entries.title: Ephesians 3:1
segments: For this reason I, Paul, the prisoner of Christ Jesus on behalf of you Gentiles--

entries.title: Ephesians 3:2
segments: for surely you have heard of the stewardship of the grace of God entrusted to me for you?

entries.title: Ephesians 3:3
segments: You have heard how by direct revelation the secret truth was made known to me, as I have already briefly written you.

entries.title: Ephesians 3:4
segments: By reading what I have written, you can judge of my insight into that secret truth of Christ

entries.title: Ephesians 3:5
segments: which was not disclosed to the sons of men in former generations, as it has now been revealed by the Spirit to his holy apostles and prophets,

entries.title: Ephesians 3:6
segments: namely, that in Christ Jesus the Gentiles form one body with us [the Jews], and are coheirs and copartners in the promise, through the gospel.

entries.title: Ephesians 3:7
segments: It is of this gospel I became a minister according to the gift of the power of the grace of God, bestowed on me by the energy of his power.

entries.title: Ephesians 3:8
segments: To me, who am less than the least of all saints, has this grace been given, that I should proclaim among the Gentiles the gospel of the unsearchable riches of Christ;

entries.title: Ephesians 3:9
segments: and should make all men see the new dispensation of that secret purpose, hidden from eternity in the God who founded the universe,

entries.title: Ephesians 3:10
segments: in order that now his manifold wisdom should, through the church, be made known to the principalities and powers in the heavenly sphere,

entries.title: Ephesians 3:11
segments: according to his eternal purpose which he purposed in Christ Jesus our Lord.

entries.title: Ephesians 3:12
segments: In him we have this fearless confidence and boldness of access through our faith in him.

entries.title: Ephesians 3:13
segments: So I beg you not to lose heart over my tribulations in your behalf; they are your glory.

entries.title: Ephesians 3:14
segments: For this cause I bend my knees before the Father,

entries.title: Ephesians 3:15
segments: from whom every fatherhood in heaven and earth is named,

entries.title: Ephesians 3:16
segments: praying him to grant you according to the riches of his glory to be strengthened with might by his Spirit in your inmost being;

entries.title: Ephesians 3:17
segments: that Christ may make his home in your hearts through your faith; that you may be so deeply rooted and so firmly grounded in love,

entries.title: Ephesians 3:18
segments: that you may be able to comprehend with all the saints what is "the breadth," "the length," "the depth," and "the height,"

entries.title: Ephesians 3:19
segments: and may know the love of Christ which transcends all knowing, so that you may be filled with all the "plenitude" of God.

entries.title: Ephesians 3:20
segments: Now unto him who, according to his might that is at work within us, is able to do infinitely more than all we ask or even think,

entries.title: Ephesians 3:21
segments: to him be the glory in the church and in Christ Jesus, to all generations, world without end, Amen.
